name: Hard (C1)
description: Hard compound tire parameters. Lowest peak grip, longest life, latest cliff threshold. Educational model -- not calibrated to specific Pirelli data.

provenance.source: Phase 3 tire model research synthesis from public F1 tire behavior characteristics
provenance.notes: Parameters are plausible engineering estimates for educational modeling. Not calibrated to any specific compound or season.

assumptionNotes.note: Peak grip, wear rates, cliff threshold, and thermal window are engineering-inference values designed to produce qualitatively realistic compound differentiation.

provenance.notes: Values chosen to demonstrate observable differences between compounds in a reduced-order model.
